messages:
sam: Heads up — after landing the new kernel-selector heuristic for Qwen-34B (prefer tiled-attn-v2 for seq<=1024) our nightly eval started failing on the conversational-quality suite. not sure if it's rope scaling or the tiled kernel change.
anya: ugh. which test regressed? short LLM e2e or long-context sims?
sam: mostly the chat-turn stability tests (turn continuity + hallucination count). failures spike when prompts include 800-1200 tokens.
jamal: that range crosses the seq threshold. tiled-attn-v2 was selected; it uses chunked RoPE handling that we changed last week.
maria: can you paste the profiler output? curious if KV-cache misses or CUDA kernel time spiked.
sam: pasted below from profiler (trimmed):
```
model: qwen-34b
kernel: tiled-attn-v2
seq: 900
avg_kernel_time: 3.4ms -> 4.9ms (+44%)
kv_cache_hits: 0.98
kv_cache_write_time: 0.5ms
rope_scale_factor: 1.05 (config override)
fallbacks: 0
```
anya: kernel time jump is suspicious but not huge. hallucination regressions usually mean RoPE math change. we did toggle the `rope_scale_factor` for numeric stability last deploy, IIRC.
jamal: yes — the tiled kernel expects scaled RoPE coordinates normalized differently. upstream change to rope_scale_factor=1.05 might misalign positional phases for heads where head_dim%64!=0.
sam: looking at a reproducer: swapping to the legacy attention kernel (attn-v1) fixes the eval result locally.
infra-bot: deploy 1825540000 completed on cluster-gpu-prod-3.6 :white_check_mark:
anya: do we have a perf/accuracy matrix for head_dim edge cases? mixtral/llama had similar issues when head dims were padded differently.
maria: quick binary check: run eval with `KERNEL_OVERRIDE=attn-v1` for the failing job, compare scores. I can kick that off.
sam: done, job queued. also added a log snippet where generation diverges at token 17.
jamal: if attn-v1 fixes quality but increases latency, we need to decide rollback vs targeted kernel disable for qwen-34b when seq>512.
anya: agree. proposal: immediate rollback of kernel-selector heuristic for Qwen-34B (fast mitigation). open follow-up to rework tiled-attn-v2 rope handling and add head-dim tests.
maria: evaluation job finished: with KERNEL_OVERRIDE=attn-v1 quality back to baseline, latency +12% but within SLO for canary users.
sam: noise: quantization toggles also present in that deploy? I saw a flag `enable_perchannel_quant=false` in the rollout.
jamal: that flag only affects model loading path; quantization shouldn't change internal attention numerics at inference time unless we swapped weight packing. not likely culprit but will verify.
anya: ops question: do we revert the code or toggle a runtime feature flag? faster to flip the kernel-selector gate. ops?
maria: I can flip the gate at runtime (gate: `prefer_tiled_attn_v2_qwen34b`). patch deployed to feature-gate service.
infra-bot: feature flip prefer_tiled_attn_v2_qwen34b -> OFF by maria at 1825554400 :white_check_mark:
sam: canary traffic now running with legacy selection. early metrics look good.
jamal: I'll create a ticket PSG-1287: "tiled-attn-v2: RoPE alignment + head_dim padding tests". include reproducer and profiler traces.
anya: add a forced test case in the kernel-selector unit tests for head_dims [64, 80, 96, 128] and seqs [512, 800, 1024, 1500].
maria: also add perf regression alerts for avg_kernel_time > baseline*1.25 on canary.
sam: for audit: recording that we rolled the feature gate rather than reverting commit. will follow up with rollback PR if we need to revert later.
jamal: action items: 1) ticket + reproducer (me), 2) add head-dim/seq tests (anya), 3) instrument per-head-phase dumps for tiled kernel (sam), 4) verify quantization packing is unchanged (maria).
anya: timeline? want a patch in 48h.
sam: ack. starting on dumps now. will ping when I have sample logs. :thumbsup:
